title: stand-test agent failure analysis
description: The machine-checkable output contract of the stand-test-debugging skill. Its two conditional rules encode the difference between an agent that finds bugs and one that hides them: a defect in the system under test is reported, never repaired by editing the test. PromptOutputSchemaResolutionTest keeps the skill's outputSchema reference pointing here.

primaryCause.description: The single primary cause. A closed vocabulary.

failureClass.description: The mechanical split the SDK already makes: StandTestAssertionError is an ASSERTION, StandTestException is INFRASTRUCTURE. A closed vocabulary.

matchedSignature.description: Identifier of the matched known signature. Absent when nothing matched and the diagnosis came from the model rather than the catalogue.

evidence.description: The observation supporting the diagnosis — what was seen, not what is believed.

repairability.description: Whether the agent may attempt a fix. A closed vocabulary.

hints.description: Bounded repair suggestions, necessarily empty for a system defect.

confidence.description: How certain the diagnosis is. A deterministic catalogue match is 1.0; a model's guess is not.

allOf.description: A system defect carries no repair hints. The test stays red and the defect is reported — a hint here is an invitation to edit the test until the bug disappears from view.

A SYSTEM_DEFECT cause must be marked unrepairable by the agent. The record enforces this too; stating it here stops the model from producing the one combination that lets a real defect enter the repair loop.

repairHint.description: One bounded repair suggestion. A closed vocabulary.
